title: Add private beta release-readiness runner
summary: Add a local umbrella readiness runner for the private beta release lane.
reason: Operators need one safe command that exercises the private beta workflow dry-run, static GitHub setup preflight, and workflow dispatch dry-run before moving to live GitHub setup, dispatch, workflow-run, artifact, and published-release verification.
behavior_before: Operators had to run several private beta release helper scripts manually and remember which ones are local/static versus live GitHub checks.
behavior_after: Operators can run a single read-only local readiness command that orchestrates the non-publishing private beta checks and returns a structured JSON summary.
manual_validation: pytest tests/python/tooling -k private_beta -q - passed (23 passed, 148 deselected)
rollback_plan: Remove the release-readiness runner script, tests, docs references, generated summaries, and this change packet.
notes: This runner must not dispatch workflows, publish releases, upload artifacts, mutate GitHub state, print secret values, or require live GitHub access in its default path.
